summary: AGI Inc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated July 27, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary Agibank was recognized by CNBC and Statista as one of the world's top fintech companies for the fourth consecutive year. The filing contains no transaction, no material corporate event, and no financial terms. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is mentioned. The release includes standard disclaimers regarding forward-looking statements and offers no securities. This is a routine current report on Form 6-K, equivalent to a U.S. press release regarding a non-material award.
